run_commands_locally: run a sequence of CommandToLaunch objects locally using an auto-selected terminal
create_CommandToLaunch: create a CommandToLaunch namedtuple with command_as_list, env_overrides, resource_name, and worker_name
get_terminal: get the best available terminal mode from gnome-terminal, tmux, xterm, or current terminal
run_commands_locally_terminal: run commands locally in a specific terminal mode like tmux_session or gnome-terminal
run_commands_locally_output: run commands locally and redirect their output to files
